name: EmbodiedBench
description: EmbodiedBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate vision-driven embodied agents across diverse tasks, from high-level semantic tasks to low-level atomic actions. It includes 1,128 testing tasks across four environments and six curated subsets assessing key agent capabilities such as commonsense reasoning, spatial awareness, and long-term planning.
reputation: A new embodied AI benchmark that is gaining attention for its breadth across semantic, navigation, and manipulation tasks, but it is still early in community adoption.
notes: Highlights challenges in low-level manipulation tasks for MLLMs; includes evaluation of 24 leading models.
